This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Spin-off Pokémon games|spin-off game]] [[New Pokémon Snap]] for the [[Nintendo Switch]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[The Pokémon Company]] and developed by {{wp|Bandai Namco Games}}. All names are given in Western order.
